The twin contradicts it: F-W9:109 prints the '16 rows' heading as a verbatim receipt, so F-W9 is right about its own roster and F-W10 is wrong about it. It is unilaterally curable — grep -c 'F.W9 roster is 17 rows' -> F-W9.md 0 / F-W10.md 1, F-W10's own prose outside the shared §2.2 splice, no delta=0 lock in the way. The substantive conclusion (sets not nested; reconciliation is F-W9's duty under R4-10) and the C:D-11 / L:L-i2 homings survive; the magnitude, the R2-7 limb and the cut count's denominator must move.
